after.scope_note: Source-selected legislative actions and letters/statements from the tracker’s four 118th/119th Congress tabs; these tabs include earlier dated actions and are not a complete congressional roll-call history. The same historical action can appear in multiple tabs; counts are source entries, not unique votes. The tracker describes its creators as anti-Zionist DSA comrades and mainly covers Democratic-caucus members. Positive/negative colors reproduce that source’s assessment, not this site’s verdict. A blank, not elected, not voting or not on committee entry does not establish a position. Sponsorships, petitions, letters and statements are labeled separately from votes. Spreadsheet grades, ranks, composite scores, endorsements and funding totals are not imported as votes or USCPR grades.
